what: Validation on/off A/B on the render bench, Gate 0 exit evidence.
harness: scripts/bench_render_ab.sh, 3 runs x 400 frames, first 30 recorded frames dropped as warmup
caveat: Debug build: absolute numbers are not shipping numbers. The ratio is the point. bench_stress is also tiny (8 draws, 108 triangles), so this measures fixed per-frame cost, not scene cost.
finding: Validation multiplies CPU render recording by 4.8x at p50. Every CPU timing recorded with validation on is unusable as a shipping number.
